adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, the new fallback path fetches a credential directly from the DB via `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` when it is not found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, and then uses it to instantiate a calendar and call `deleteEvent(...)`. The diff shows no `select` (so the full credential row, including secret `key`, is loaded) and no scoping constraint like `userId: bookingToDelete.userId` / `teamId` ownership. This expands behavior beyond the prior logic (which only used credentials already attached to the booking user) and could allow operations using a credential referenced by `bookingToDelete.references` even if it doesn't belong to the organizer/user, i.e., cross-credential event deletion risk.
